additional_info.subject: RE: 0374518 - ID0374518-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / S1 170003243]-Ocpp router is toggling CRM:00641000634
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin,
Trust all is well.
Regarding the issue, we have analyzed the logs and reviewed the router configuration remotely. It appears that the problem lies with the network, as all other parameters are correct. As you can see in the images below, there are entries showing multiple instances in a single day where the mobile data was connected and disconnected.
We recommend ensuring strong network signal strength near the charger. If the network remains unstable, we can change the WAN configuration to Ethernet, which offers lower latency.
The RSRP is higher in the second image which states as "
Reliable data speeds may be attained, but marginal data with drop-outs is possible. When this value gets close to -100, performance will drop drastically".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.body:
Hello Martin,
We checked the router settings again and found that all the settings are correct. But we can still see network disconnections.
We have also checked the OCPP configuration which has WebSocketPingInterval as 30 sec and HeartBeatTimeInterval as 240 sec. which is also correct for stable OCPP connection.
But we can still see network disconnections in network event history.
It seems like OCPP disconnected due to network issue.
Please let us know if you have any other queries.
Thank you.
With best regards,
